summary.title: CGM full-chain production-shaped diagnostic repeated board summary
summary.label: cgm_phase020_full_chain_repeated

metadata.dataset: synthetic CGM diagnostic workloads; case label defines exact input shape

comparisons.name: full_chain_320x240

baseline.label: Std build
baseline.checksum_policy: FNV-style checksum over filtered one-hot uint8_t map
baseline.timer_boundary: computeSobelQuantizedFilteredCandidate, Sobel max-channel selection, magnitude/angle quantize, quantized-map extraction and 3x3 dominant-bin filter
baseline.gate: organized pcl::RGB image, width>=3, height>=3, borders are zero-filled at each subchain boundary
baseline.mask: magnitude_threshold predicate followed by 3x3 bin equality masks for directions 1..8
baseline.reduction: scalar Sobel staging, RVV per-lane sqrt/atan2/angle quantize, then lane-wise dominant filter equality count
baseline.asm_boundary: computeSobelQuantizedFilteredCandidate / inlined RVV math and byte filter in bench_cgm_rvv

candidate.label: RVV build
candidate.checksum_policy: FNV-style checksum over filtered one-hot uint8_t map
candidate.timer_boundary: computeSobelQuantizedFilteredCandidate, Sobel max-channel selection, magnitude/angle quantize, quantized-map extraction and 3x3 dominant-bin filter
candidate.gate: organized pcl::RGB image, width>=3, height>=3, borders are zero-filled at each subchain boundary
candidate.mask: magnitude_threshold predicate followed by 3x3 bin equality masks for directions 1..8
candidate.reduction: scalar Sobel staging, RVV per-lane sqrt/atan2/angle quantize, then lane-wise dominant filter equality count
candidate.asm_boundary: computeSobelQuantizedFilteredCandidate / inlined RVV math and byte filter in bench_cgm_rvv

comparisons.notes: Phase 020 production-shaped diagnostic. It does not call ColorGradientModality::processInputData and does not include Gaussian smoothing, spread or feature extraction.
